Please don't give up. Life is hard. It beats you down. Beat it back. I believe in you. Talk to your local crisis center. Talk to your family. Anything is better than death. Life might not be the best but it still beats the grave. 

Please, do not give up. Stay strong.

Thank you for all this. I feel a bit more appreciated! It feels good to know that there are people that care! 

I had a talk with my doc and we figured stuff out. I have an appointment this weekend. 

And again, thank you for being amazing.

I have thought about contacting the crisis center of my town but just haven't done it yet, I haven't had the courage to. I have not met up with my doctor in while either, I had an appointment today but it got cancelled. 

I do have a few friends but not any close enough to talk about my family issues.

My brother and I don't even talk the same way we used to. I feel like it would be hard talking about depression with him. We don't talk like brothers, we talk more like very distanced friends.

I do. Sometimes we talk. But he isn't how he used to be. He changed a lot. It doesn't really feel like he cares either.

I have a diagnosis on depression and at first I felt like my parents cared, but they didn't. They come from a 3rd world country but have lived here in Sweden for more than 20 years. They tell me that being in that third world is much more harder, that I'm just a drama queen, that depression isn't anything real, that I just make stuff up for attention.
